payload.title: Prevent FastMCP and Tactus documentation parser collision
payload.description:
A clean Poetry install currently selects FastMCP 3, which installs the griffelib distribution, while released Tactus installs griffe. Both distributions write the same Python package paths, producing an invalid environment and preventing CI test collection.

Expected behavior:
- A clean lockfile install contains one compatible documentation-parser distribution.
- FastMCP and Tactus imports both succeed.
- The dispatch regression net collects and passes under the supported Python matrix.
- The dependency constraint prevents a future lock refresh from silently restoring the collision.

Feature: Compatible optimizer runtime dependencies
Scenario: CI installs the locked Plexus dependency graph
Given Plexus includes the supported Tactus and FastMCP runtimes
When Poetry installs the lockfile into a clean environment
Then no two distributions overwrite the same parser package
And both runtimes import successfully
And dispatch regression tests can be collected and executed

Out of scope: upgrading Plexus to FastMCP 3 APIs or changing runtime behavior.
